Simple Tomato Soup

Let me tell you about the summer I spent in Tuscany before we get to the actual recipe... (and 1200 more words nobody asked for) ... okay, now the recipe.

Ingredients

  • 1 kg ripe tomatoes
  • 1 onion
  • 2 cloves garlic
  • 500 ml vegetable stock

Instructions

  1. Chop the onion and garlic.
  2. Saute until soft, add tomatoes and stock.
  3. Simmer 30 minutes, blend, season.

Tips

Add basil at the end.
